source: Kedah 2026 · Paper 2 · Part 2 Q2 · Essay, 125–150 words
paragraphs: In this digital era, entertainment media has become an inseparable part of students' lives. One type of entertainment media that helps my learning is educational YouTube videos. Channels such as Crash Course explain difficult topics in a lively and engaging way.

First and foremost, this media helps me in my studies by simplifying complex concepts through vivid animations. As a result, I can grasp abstract topics such as chemical bonding more easily. Furthermore, it allows me to learn at my own pace. I can pause and replay a video whenever I am confused.

Students can control their screen time by setting a daily limit on their phones. This prevents them from mindlessly scrolling for hours. Moreover, they should keep their phones out of reach while studying. This helps them stay focused. In a nutshell, entertainment media is a double-edged sword, so we must use it wisely.
